title: Wire group-log reconciliation on inbound gossip tips
description: When the gossipsub event loop receives a tip advertisement, trigger group_log reconciliation: compare local tip vs received tip, initiate backfill if behind. Wire the backfill logic (already in core::group_log::backfill) to the transit IPFS store to fetch missing blocks. Why: without reconciliation, peers never sync their group logs and articles received over gossip are lost.
